title: 第2章 一人十万
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年

第(1/3)页

穿越倒计时：７天。

谭筝拿着首饰盒走进金店，径直走到柜台前。

“我要卖黄金。”

眼下金价持续走高，店里来往客人大多是购入，出手变卖的寥寥无几。

店员闻言立刻迎上来，态度十分热情：“女士您好，请把东西拿出来给我看看。”

店员拿起首饰仔细查看，片刻后，神色为难：“不好意思女士，这些我们收不了。”

一听这话，谭筝顿时急了。

“为什么不收？这些首饰当初还是在你们品牌买的呢，发票我都还留着！”

她迅速从首饰盒底下翻出发票，递到店员眼前。

店员接过扫了一眼，神色更古怪了：“女士，我们品牌叫程大福，不叫程太福。”

谭筝一把夺过发票，定睛一看，天杀的，这还真是个盗版货？！

“那……那就算不是你们品牌的，但材质总归是一样的吧？我着急脱手，价格低一点也没事。”

此刻谭筝只当程太福是蹭热度的仿冒杂牌，顶多是做工差些，品质相差不大，就好比雪碧和雷碧，六个核桃和六个核弹……

“您这一整套首饰看着像足金，实则全是镀金外包，内里都是普通合金，一点真金都没有。”

“你说什么？这些全是假的？”谭筝满脸错愕，“你是不是验错了，再好好看看！这可是订婚要用的三金，怎么可能是假的！”

得知订婚要用的三金全是假货，周遭围观顾客看向谭筝的眼神里，纷纷染上几分同情。

“您要是不信，我可以当场用火验金。”

“好。”

不到黄河心不死，谭筝点头应允。

店员拿出点火器具，对着金镯缓缓灼烧，不过片刻功夫，光洁的镯子迅速发黑变色。

看到眼前的这一幕，谭筝心底的怒气再也无法抑制。

大爷的！竟然敢骗她！

离开金店后，她拨通了江洲的电话。

“嘟——嘟——”

电话响了许久，始终无人接听。

谭筝估摸着江洲应该在家，索性直接杀过去，问个清楚。

不从江洲身上宰一笔，她咽不下这口气！

Page (1/3)

Countdown to time travel: 7 days.

Tan Zheng walked into the gold shop with the jewelry box and walked straight to the counter.

"I want to sell gold."

At present, the price of gold continues to rise. Most of the customers in the store are buying, and only a few are selling.

Upon hearing this, the clerk immediately came over to greet me with a very enthusiastic attitude: "Hello, madam, please take out the things and show me."

The clerk picked up the jewelry and inspected it carefully. After a moment, he looked embarrassed and said, "Sorry, madam, we can't accept these."

Upon hearing this, Tan Zheng suddenly became anxious.

"Why don't you accept it? I bought these jewelry from your brand originally, and I still keep the invoice!"

She quickly pulled out the invoice from under the jewelry box and handed it to the clerk.

The clerk took it and glanced at it, his expression even weirder: "Madam, our brand is called Cheng Dafu, not Cheng Taifu."

Tan Zheng grabbed the invoice and took a closer look. Damn it, is this really a pirated item?!

"Then...even if it's not your brand, the material is still the same, right? I'm in a hurry to sell it, so it's okay if the price is lower."

At this moment, Tan Zheng only thinks that Cheng Taifu is a popular counterfeit brand. At most, the workmanship is poor and the quality is not much different, just like Sprite and Lei Bi, six walnuts and six nuclear bombs...

"Your whole set of jewelry looks like pure gold, but in fact it's all gold-plated on the outside. It's all ordinary alloy on the inside. There's no real gold at all."

"What did you say? These are all fakes?" Tan Zheng's face was full of astonishment. "Did you make a mistake in the test? Take a closer look! These are the three pieces of gold required for an engagement, how could they be fake!"

After learning that the three gold items needed for the engagement were all fake, the onlookers looked at Tan Zheng with a bit of sympathy in their eyes.

"If you don't believe it, I can test the gold with fire on the spot."

"Okay."

Tan Zheng nodded and agreed.

The clerk took out a fire starter and slowly burned the gold bracelet. Within a moment, the smooth bracelet quickly turned black and discolored.

Seeing this scene in front of him, Tan Zheng could no longer suppress the anger in his heart.

Uncle's!How dare you lie to her!

After leaving the gold shop, she dialed Jiang Zhou's phone number.

"Du-du--"

The phone rang for a long time, but no one answered.

Tan Zheng guessed that Jiang Zhou should be at home, so he simply went over to him and asked him clearly.

She wouldn't be able to swallow this breath without taking a huge cut from Jiang Zhou!
